name: Kasol Manali Group Trip
route: Kasol → Kasol Exploration & Manikaran Visit → Kasol → Manali → Kullu → Sissu & Solang Valley → Atal Tunnel → Manali → Chandigarh & Train Journey
highlights: Scenic train journey from Ahmedabad to Chandigarh
Explore the peaceful vibes of Kasol and Parvati Valley
Visit Manikaran Gurudwara and local markets
Riverside café hopping experience in Kasol
Adventure activities: river rafting in Kullu & paragliding
Visit Atal Tunnel and the picturesque village of Sissu
Explore Solang Valley and Manali attractions
Group bonding activities and fun travel experiences
Ahmedabad → Chandigarh → Kasol → Manali → Solang Valley → Sissu → Chandigarh → Ahmedabad
Carry valid ID proof for travel and hotel check-ins
Weather in Himachal can be unpredictable; pack warm clothing
Adventure activities are optional and payable directly
Comfortable footwear is recommended for sightseeing and short treks
Follow safety instructions during activities and travel

itinerary.title: Departure from Ahmedabad (Train Journey)
itinerary.desc: Report at Gandhinagar Railway Station Board train for Chandigarh Enjoy overnight journey through Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Haryana Engage in group activities and interactions onboard

itinerary.title: Arrival in Chandigarh & Transfer to Kasol
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Chandigarh in the morning Drive to Kasol (approx. 7–8 hours) Check-in and relax upon arrival Dinner and overnight stay in Kasol

itinerary.title: Kasol Exploration & Manikaran Visit
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at hotel Visit Manikaran Gurudwara Explore Kasol Market Evening café hopping by the riverside Dinner and overnight stay in Kasol

itinerary.title: Kasol to Manali via Kullu (Adventure Day)
itinerary.desc: Breakfast and departure for Manali En route enjoy: River rafting in Beas River (optional) Paragliding experience (optional) Arrival in Manali and check-in Dinner and overnight stay

itinerary.title: Sissu & Solang Valley via Atal Tunnel
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at hotel Drive through Atal Tunnel to Sissu Explore Solang Valley and enjoy scenic views Visit Sissu village in Lahaul Valley Return to Manali Dinner and overnight stay

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at hotel Visit major attractions: Hadimba Devi Temple Vashisht Temple (hot springs) Mall Road and Old Manali Optional short trek to Jogini Waterfall Evening free for shopping and leisure Dinner and overnight stay

itinerary.title: Return to Chandigarh & Train Journey
itinerary.desc: Morning departure to Chandigarh Board train back to Ahmedabad Enjoy overnight journey with group

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ahmedabad
itinerary.desc: Reach Ahmedabad by afternoon Trip concludes with memorable experiences ✅ Inclusions Train tickets (Ahmedabad–Chandigarh–Ahmedabad) Accommodation on sharing basis (2/3 sharing) Daily breakfast and dinner (as per itinerary) Tempo Traveller for local transportation Sightseeing as per itinerary Trip leader and 24/7 assistance All tolls, parking charges, and permits ❌ Exclusions GST (5%) Adventure activity charges (rafting, paragliding, etc.) Lunch and meals during transit Personal expenses (shopping, snacks, laundry, etc.) Additional costs due to weather, roadblocks, or delays Any services not mentioned in inclusions
